text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Tracen Academy may be big, but I've never gotten lost.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Why would I? I already had the map
from the
campus pamphlets memorized
long before I even
started here.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And now, whenever someone asks me for

directions, I can give them calmly and

promptly. ♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Got that? If you're going to be my
trainer, you'd
better have this place
memorized as well!
